bio: A glass of crisp rosé with a fine selection of cured meats in the wine bar or on the canal-side terrace, a few small plates to share, or a complete meal in the restaurant, with its floral, slightly tropical-looking decor… You have plenty of options here. The tempting menu includes an intensely flavoursome ceviche, a vegetarian dish based on dry-aged beetroot, and a rich tarte Tatin. The chefs are just as happy to play with exotic seasonings as they are to turn out distinctly Dutch dishes. In short: delicious, inspired and generous!...
